metadata.method: Schmidt orthogonalization with companion matrix eigenvalue decomposition
metadata.algorithm: RDK (Rys, Dupuis, King 1976) via libcint-style implementation
metadata.reference: Dupuis, M., Rys, J., & King, H.F. (1976). J. Chem. Phys. 65, 111.
metadata.description: Rys quadrature roots and weights for IQCP validation
notes: Moment reconstruction: sum_k w_k * r_k^m = F_m(T) for m = 0..2n-1
Different implementations may produce numerically different roots/weights
The defining property is moment reconstruction, not exact root values
For regression testing, use the IQCP implementation's own output as reference
This file serves as cross-validation data and algorithm documentation
